title: Which jump sizes land on both twenty eight and seventy?
description: Treasures sit on twenty eight and seventy. Listing the factors of each number and keeping the common ones gives the jump sizes that land on both, and a check puts them back.
teaching_notes: One idea: the jump sizes that land on both numbers are their common factors. Watch for students who stop at the biggest common factor.

source: Figure it Out box 2, Q7, p.111
video_script.why: The child lists the factors of both treasure numbers and keeps the ones in both lists.
video_script.substitution: List the factors of each number and keep those in both lists.
video_script.anchor: the treasure game of the book: Jia has kept treasures on twenty eight and seventy
video_script.payoff_line: The jump sizes are one, two, seven and fourteen

final_answer.spoken: the jump sizes are one, two, seven and fourteen

names.Jia: keeps the treasures in the treasure game

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the jump sizes that land on both.
<bookmark mark='list'/>Step one, list the factors of twenty eight. They are one, two, four, seven, fourteen and twenty eight.
<bookmark mark='list'/>Step two, list the factors of seventy. They are one, two, five, seven, ten, fourteen, thirty five and seventy.

narration: <bookmark mark='both'/>Step three, find the factors in both lists. They are one, two, seven and fourteen.
<bookmark mark='rest'/>Four and twenty eight are only in the first list. Five, ten, thirty five and seventy are only in the second.

marks.two: 2 x 14 = 28 and 2 x 35 = 70 are written and all get a tick

narration: <bookmark mark='fourteen'/>Step four, put them back. Fourteen times two is twenty eight, and fourteen times five is seventy.
<bookmark mark='seven'/>Seven times four is twenty eight, and seven times ten is seventy.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Two times fourteen is twenty eight, and two times thirty five is seventy. One lands on every number.

beats.on_screen: Answer: the jump sizes are 1, 2, 7 and 14
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The jump sizes are one, two, seven and fourteen.
